Zakorači desnom nogom unatrag oko 60 centimetara od lijevog stopala i spusti tijelo, uspravnog trupa i u ravnoteži. Tijekom spuštanja udahni. Savjet: prednje koljeno ne smije otići ispred prstiju, a prednja potkoljenica je okomita na pod. Trup je uspravan, pa su gipki pregibači kuka važni. Dugi iskorak više naglašava veliki gluteus, a kratki prednju ložu.
Uz izdah se odgurni i vrati u početni položaj. Savjet: odgurivanje prednjim dijelom stopala više naglašava prednju ložu, a petama gluteuse.
Ponovi drugom nogom.

en: Begin standing with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips.

Step forward with one leg, flexing the knees to drop your hips. Descend until your rear knee nearly touches the ground. Your posture should remain upright, and your front knee should stay above the front foot.
Drive through the heel of your lead foot and extend both knees to raise yourself back up.
Step forward with your rear foot, repeating the lunge on the opposite leg.
hr: Stani sa stopalima u širini ramena i rukama na bokovima.
Zakorači naprijed jednom nogom i savij koljena da spustiš kukove. Spuštaj se dok stražnje koljeno gotovo ne dotakne pod. Držanje je uspravno, a prednje koljeno ostaje iznad prednjeg stopala.
Odgurni se petom prednje noge i ispruži oba koljena da se podigneš.
Zakorači naprijed stražnjom nogom i ponovi iskorak drugom nogom.

en: Position yourself into a staggered stance with the rear foot elevated and front foot forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, letting them hang at the sides. This will be your starting position.
Begin by descending, flexing your knee and hip to lower your body down. Maintain good posture througout the movement. Keep the front knee in line with the foot as you perform the exercise.
At the bottom of the movement, drive through the heel to extend the knee and hip to return to the starting position.
hr: Stani u iskorak, sa stražnjim stopalom na povišenju i prednjim stopalom naprijed.
Drži bučicu u svakoj ruci, s rukama opuštenima uz tijelo. To je početni položaj.
Spuštaj se savijanjem koljena i kuka. Drži dobro držanje tijekom cijelog pokreta, a prednje koljeno u liniji sa stopalom.
U donjem položaju odgurni se petom, ispruži koljeno i kuk i vrati se u početni položaj.

en: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Place the right foot on the elevated platform. Step on the platform by extending the hip and the knee of your right leg. Use the heel mainly to lift the rest of your body up and place the foot of the left leg on the platform as well. Breathe out as you execute the force required to come up.

Step down with the left leg by flexing the hip and knee of the right leg as you inhale. Return to the original standing position by placing the right foot of to next to the left foot on the initial position.
Repeat with the right leg for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.
hr: Stani uspravno s bučicom u svakoj ruci (dlanovi prema nogama).
Desno stopalo stavi na povišenje. Popni se ispružanjem kuka i koljena desne noge, odgurujući se uglavnom petom, i stavi i lijevo stopalo na povišenje. Tijekom penjanja izdahni.
Uz udah spusti lijevu nogu savijanjem kuka i koljena desne noge. Vrati se u početni položaj tako da desno stopalo spustiš pokraj lijevog.
Ponovi desnom nogom preporučeni broj ponavljanja, a zatim isto napravi lijevom.

en: For this exercise load a trap bar, also known as a hex bar, to an appropriate weight resting on the ground. Stand in the center of the apparatus and grasp both handles.
Lower your hips, look forward with your head and keep your chest up.
Begin the movement by driving through the heels and extend your hips and knees. Avoid rounding your back at all times.
At the completion of the movement, lower the weight back to the ground under control.
hr: Opterećenu trap šipku (zovu je i hex šipka) postavi na pod. Stani u sredinu šipke i uhvati obje ručke.
Spusti kukove, gledaj naprijed i drži prsa podignutima.
Odgurni se petama i ispruži kukove i koljena. Leđa nikad ne zaokružuj.
Na kraju pokreta kontrolirano spusti teret natrag na pod.

en: Put a barbell in front of you on the ground and grab it using a pronated (palms facing down) grip that a little wider than shoulder width. Tip: Depending on the weight used, you may need wrist wraps to perform the exercise and also a raised platform in order to allow for better range of motion.
Bend the knees slightly and keep the shins vertical, hips back and back straight. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your back and arms completely straight at all times, use your hips to lift the bar as you exhale. Tip: The movement should not be fast but steady and under control.

Once you are standing completely straight up, lower the bar by pushing the hips back, only slightly bending the knees, unlike when squatting. Tip: Take a deep breath at the start of the movement and keep your chest up. Hold your breath as you lower and exhale as you complete the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Postavi šipku na pod ispred sebe i uhvati je nathvatom (dlanovi prema dolje) malo širim od ramena. Savjet: ovisno o težini, možda će ti trebati trake za zapešća, a povišenje pod stopalima omogućuje veći opseg pokreta.
Lagano savij koljena, potkoljenice drži okomito, kukove unatrag, a leđa ravna. To je početni položaj.
Leđa i ruke su cijelo vrijeme potpuno ravni. Uz izdah kukovima podigni šipku. Savjet: pokret nije brz, nego ujednačen i pod kontrolom.

Kad se potpuno uspraviš, spuštaj šipku gurajući kukove unatrag, s koljenima samo lagano savijenima, za razliku od čučnja. Savjet: na početku pokreta duboko udahni i drži prsa podignutima. Zadrži dah tijekom spuštanja i izdahni na kraju pokreta.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Grasp a bar using an overhand grip (palms facing down). You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the barbell to over the top of your feet by bending at the hips while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips until you are back at the starting position. Exhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Uhvati šipku nathvatom (dlanovi prema dolje). Uz veće težine možda će ti trebati trake za zapešća.
Stani uspravno, sa stopalima u širini ramena ili uže. Koljena su lagano savijena. To je početni položaj.

Držeći koljena mirnima, spuštaj šipku do iznad stopala savijanjem u kukovima, ravnih leđa. Spuštaj se kao da nešto podižeš s poda, dok ne osjetiš istezanje u stražnjoj loži. Tijekom ovog dijela udahni.
Ispruži kukove i uspravi trup natrag u početni položaj. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

name.hr: Mrtvo dizanje s ravnim nogama s bučicama

en: Grasp a couple of dumbbells holding them by your side at arm's length.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the dumbbells to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips and waist until you are back at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Uzmi dvije bučice i drži ih uz tijelo na ispruženim rukama.
Stani uspravno, sa stopalima u širini ramena ili uže. Koljena su lagano savijena. To je početni položaj.

Držeći koljena mirnima, spuštaj bučice do iznad stopala savijanjem u kukovima, ravnih leđa. Spuštaj se kao da nešto podižeš s poda, dok ne osjetiš istezanje u stražnjoj loži. Tijekom ovog dijela udahni.
Ispruži kukove i uspravi trup natrag u početni položaj. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Begin with a bar loaded on the ground. Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip. Relax the shoulders, which in effect lengthens your arms.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.
hr: Opterećena šipka je na podu. Priđi joj tako da prelazi preko sredine stopala. Stopala su vrlo široko, blizu obruča. Savij se u kukovima i uhvati šipku. Ruke su točno ispod ramena, unutar nogu. Možeš koristiti nathvat, mješoviti ili hook hvat. Opusti ramena, čime ruke postaju dulje.
Udahni, spusti kukove, gledaj naprijed i drži prsa podignutima. Odgurni se od poda, razmičući stopala, s težinom na stražnjoj polovici stopala. Ispruži kukove i koljena.
Kad šipka prođe koljena, nagni se unatrag i gurni kukove prema šipki, skupljajući lopatice.
Spusti teret na pod savijanjem u kukovima, kontrolirano.

en: Begin with a bar on a rack at shoulder height. Rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your shoulders. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Step back from the rack.
Begin by bending at the hips, moving them back as you bend over to near parallel. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Reverse the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings. Continue until you have returned to the starting position.
hr: Šipka je na stalku u visini ramena. Nasloni je na stražnju stranu ramena kao za čučanj, ne na vrh ramena. Leđa su stegnuta, lopatice skupljene, a koljena lagano savijena. Zakorači unatrag od stalka.
Savij se u kukovima, gurajući ih unatrag, dok trup ne bude gotovo paralelan s podom. Leđa su izvijena, a vrat u ravnini s kralježnicom.
Vrati se ispružanjem kukova, gluteusima i stražnjom ložom, do početnog položaja.

en: Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad of the lever on the back of your legs (just a few inches under the calves). Tip: Preferably use a leg curl machine that is angled as opposed to flat since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment.

Keeping the torso flat on the bench, ensure your legs are fully stretched and grab the side handles of the machine. Position your toes straight (or you can also use any of the other two stances described on the foot positioning section). This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, curl your legs up as far as possible without lifting the upper legs from the pad. Once you hit the fully contracted position, hold it for a second.
As you inhale, bring the legs back to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Namjesti polugu sprave prema svojoj visini i lezi licem prema dolje na spravu za pregib nogu, s jastučićem poluge na stražnjoj strani nogu (nekoliko centimetara ispod listova). Savjet: ako možeš, odaberi spravu s nagnutim ležajem, jer kut bolje aktivira stražnju ložu.
Trup je ravno na klupi, noge potpuno ispružene, a rukama drži bočne ručke. Prsti na stopalima gledaju ravno. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah savij noge što više možeš, bez odvajanja natkoljenica od jastuka. U gornjem položaju zadrži sekundu.
Uz udah vrati noge u početni položaj. Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and sit on the machine with your back against the back support pad.

Place the back of lower leg on top of padded lever (just a few inches under the calves) and secure the lap pad against your thighs, just above the knees. Then grasp the side handles on the machine as you point your toes straight (or you can also use any of the other two stances) and ensure that the legs are fully straight right in front of you. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, pull the machine lever as far as possible to the back of your thighs by flexing at the knees. Keep your torso stationary at all times. Hold the contracted position for a second.
Slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Namjesti polugu sprave prema svojoj visini i sjedni na spravu, s leđima na naslonu.

Stražnju stranu potkoljenica stavi na jastučić poluge (nekoliko centimetara ispod listova) i spusti jastučić za bedra tik iznad koljena. Uhvati bočne ručke, prsti na stopalima gledaju ravno, a noge su potpuno ispružene ispred tebe. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah savijanjem koljena povuci polugu što više prema stražnjoj strani bedara. Trup cijelo vrijeme miruje. Zadrži sekundu u stisnutom položaju.
Uz udah se polako vrati u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and lie with your torso bent at the waist facing forward around 30-45 degrees (since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment) with the pad of the lever on the back of your right leg (just a few inches under the calves) and the front of the right leg on top of the machine pad.
Keeping the torso bent forward, ensure your leg is fully stretched and grab the side handles of the machine. Position your toes straight. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, curl your right leg up as far as possible without lifting the upper leg from the pad. Once you hit the fully contracted position, hold it for a second.
As you inhale, bring the legs back to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Perform the same exercise now for the left leg.
hr: Namjesti polugu sprave prema svojoj visini i nasloni se s trupom nagnutim naprijed za 30 do 45 stupnjeva (kut bolje aktivira stražnju ložu). Jastučić poluge je na stražnjoj strani desne noge (nekoliko centimetara ispod lista), a prednja strana desne noge na jastuku sprave.
S trupom nagnutim naprijed, noga je potpuno ispružena, a rukama drži bočne ručke. Prsti na stopalu gledaju ravno. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah savij desnu nogu što više možeš, bez odvajanja natkoljenice od jastuka. U gornjem položaju zadrži sekundu.
Uz udah vrati nogu u početni položaj. Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.
Ponovi vježbu lijevom nogom.

en: Begin by adjusting the equipment to fit your body. Place your feet against the footplate in between the rollers as you lie facedown. Your knees should be just behind the pad.

Start from the bottom of the movement. Keep your back arched as you begin the movement by flexing the knees. Drive your toes into the foot plate as you do so. Keep your upper body straight, and continue until your body is upright.
Return to the starting position, keeping your descent under control.
hr: Namjesti spravu prema svom tijelu. Lezi licem prema dolje i stopala postavi na ploču između valjaka. Koljena su tik iza jastuka.
Kreni iz donjeg položaja. Leđa su izvijena, a pokret počinješ savijanjem koljena, gurajući prste u ploču. Gornji dio tijela drži ravnim i nastavi dok ne budeš uspravan.
Kontrolirano se spusti u početni položaj.

en: Begin on the floor laying on your back with your feet on top of the ball.
Position the ball so that when your legs are extended your ankles are on top of the ball. This will be your starting position.
Raise your hips off of the ground, keeping your weight on the shoulder blades and your feet.
Flex the knees, pulling the ball as close to you as you can, contracting the hamstrings.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
hr: Lezi na leđa na pod, sa stopalima na lopti.
Namjesti loptu tako da su gležnjevi na njoj kad su noge ispružene. To je početni položaj.
Podigni kukove od poda, s težinom na lopaticama i stopalima.
Savij koljena i privuci loptu što bliže sebi, stežući stražnju ložu.
Nakon kratke pauze vrati se u početni položaj.

en: Place your feet between the pads after loading an appropriate weight. Lay on the top pad, allowing your hips to hang off the back, while grasping the handles to hold your position.
To begin the movement, flex the hips, pulling the legs forward.
Reverse the motion by extending the hips, kicking the leg back. It is very important not to over-extend the hip on this movement, stopping short of your full range of motion.
Return by again flexing the hip, pulling the carriage forward as far as you can.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
hr: Stavi odgovarajući teret i postavi stopala između jastučića. Lezi na gornji jastuk tako da kukovi vise preko ruba i drži se za ručke.
Savij kukove i povuci noge naprijed.
Ispruži kukove i zamahni nogama unatrag. Važno je ne prepružiti kuk, pa stani malo prije kraja opsega pokreta.
Ponovno savij kukove i povuci noge naprijed koliko možeš.
Ponovi željeni broj ponavljanja.

name.hr: Mrtvo dizanje na jednoj nozi s kettlebellom

en: Hold a kettlebell by the handle in one hand. Stand on one leg, on the same side that you hold the kettlebell.
Keeping that knee slightly bent, perform a stiff legged deadlift by bending at the hip, extending your free leg behind you for balance.
Continue lowering the kettlebell until you are parallel to the ground, and then return to the upright position.
hr: Drži kettlebell za ručku u jednoj ruci. Stani na nogu s iste strane na kojoj držiš kettlebell.
S lagano savijenim koljenom napravi mrtvo dizanje ravnih nogu savijanjem u kuku, a slobodnu nogu ispruži iza sebe radi ravnoteže.
Spuštaj kettlebell dok trup ne bude paralelan s podom, a zatim se vrati u uspravan položaj.

en: Begin seated on the ground with a bench directly behind you. Have a loaded barbell over your legs. Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise.
Roll the bar so that it is directly above your hips, and lean back against the bench so that your shoulder blades are near the top of it.

Begin the movement by driving through your feet, extending your hips vertically through the bar. Your weight should be supported by your shoulder blades and your feet. Extend as far as possible, then reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
hr: Sjedni na pod s klupom odmah iza sebe i opterećenom šipkom preko nogu. Deblja šipka ili jastučić na šipki znatno smanjuju nelagodu.
Prevaljaj šipku tako da bude točno iznad kukova i nasloni se leđima na klupu, tako da su lopatice blizu njezina ruba.
Odgurni se stopalima i podigni kukove okomito prema gore kroz šipku. Težinu nose lopatice i stopala. Ispruži kukove što više možeš, a zatim se vrati u početni položaj.

en: Begin seated on the ground with a loaded barbell over your legs. Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise. Roll the bar so that it is directly above your hips, and lay down flat on the floor.
Begin the movement by driving through with your heels, extending your hips vertically through the bar. Your weight should be supported by your upper back and the heels of your feet.
Extend as far as possible, then reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
hr: Sjedni na pod s opterećenom šipkom preko nogu. Deblja šipka ili jastučić na šipki znatno smanjuju nelagodu. Prevaljaj šipku tako da bude točno iznad kukova i lezi ravno na pod.
Odgurni se petama i podigni kukove okomito prema gore kroz šipku. Težinu nose gornji dio leđa i pete.
Ispruži kukove što više možeš, a zatim se vrati u početni položaj.

en: Lay on the floor with your feet flat and knees bent.
Raise one leg off of the ground, pulling the knee to your chest. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by driving through the heel, extending your hip upward and raising your glutes off of the ground.
Extend as far as possible, pause and then return to the starting position.
hr: Lezi na pod, sa stopalima na podu i savijenim koljenima.
Podigni jednu nogu i privuci koljeno prema prsima. To je početni položaj.
Odgurni se petom druge noge, ispruži kuk prema gore i podigni gluteuse od poda.
Ispruži kuk što više možeš, zastani i vrati se u početni položaj.

en: Kneel on the floor or an exercise mat and bend at the waist with your arms extended in front of you (perpendicular to the torso) in order to get into a kneeling push-up position but with the arms spaced at shoulder width. Your head should be looking forward and the bend of the knees should create a 90-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, lift up your right leg until the hamstrings are in line with the back while maintaining the 90-degree angle bend. Contract the glutes throughout this movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second. Tip: At the end of the movement the upper leg should be parallel to the floor while the calf should be perpendicular to it.
Go back to the initial position as you inhale and now repeat with the left leg.
Continue to alternate legs until all of the recommended repetitions have been performed.
hr: Klekni na pod ili prostirku i nagni se naprijed, s rukama ispruženima ispred sebe (okomito na trup) u širini ramena, kao za sklek na koljenima. Gledaj naprijed. Koljena su savijena pod 90 stupnjeva. To je početni položaj.

Uz izdah podigni desnu nogu dok natkoljenica ne bude u liniji s leđima, zadržavajući koljeno savijeno pod 90 stupnjeva. Steži gluteuse tijekom cijelog pokreta i zadrži sekundu na vrhu. Savjet: na kraju pokreta natkoljenica je paralelna s podom, a potkoljenica okomita na njega.
Uz udah se vrati u početni položaj i ponovi lijevom nogom.
Nastavi naizmjence dok ne napraviš sva preporučena ponavljanja.

en: Hook a leather ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and then attach the cuff to your ankle.
Face the weight stack from a distance of about two feet, grasping the steel frame for support.

While keeping your knees and hips bent slightly and your abs tight, contract your glutes to slowly "kick" the working leg back in a semicircular arc as high as it will comfortably go as you breathe out. Tip: At full extension, squeeze your glutes for a second in order to achieve a peak contraction.
Now slowly bring your working leg forward, resisting the pull of the cable until you reach the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the movement for the other side.
hr: Zakači manžetu za gležanj na donji kolotur i pričvrsti je oko gležnja.
Stani licem prema stupu utega, na oko 60 centimetara, i drži se za okvir sprave.
S lagano savijenim koljenima i kukovima i stegnutim trbuhom, uz izdah gluteusima polako zamahni radnom nogom unatrag u polukružnom luku, koliko ugodno ide. Savjet: na vrhu stisni gluteuse na sekundu.
Polako vrati nogu naprijed, odupirući se povlačenju kabla, do početnog položaja.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.
Zamijeni nogu i ponovi s druge strane.

en: Begin standing a few feet in front of a low pulley with a rope or handle attached. Face away from the machine, straddling the cable, with your feet set wide apart.

Begin the movement by reaching through your legs as far as possible, bending at the hips. Keep your knees slightly bent. Keeping your arms straight, extend through the hip to stand straight up. Avoid pulling upward through the shoulders; all of the motion should originate through the hips.
hr: Stani nekoliko koraka ispred donjeg kolotura s užetom ili ručkom. Okreni se leđima spravi, s kablom između nogu i stopalima široko razmaknutima.
Savij se u kukovima i posegni rukama što dalje kroz noge. Koljena su lagano savijena. Ravnih ruku ispruži kukove i uspravi se. Ne vuci ramenima: cijeli pokret dolazi iz kukova.

en: To begin, sit down on the abductor machine and select a weight you are comfortable with. When your legs are positioned properly, grip the handles on each side. Your entire upper body (from the waist up) should be stationary. This is the starting position.
Slowly press against the machine with your legs to move them away from each other while exhaling.

Feel the contraction for a second and begin to move your legs back to the starting position while breathing in. Note: Remember to keep your upper body stationary to prevent any injuries from occurring.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Sjedni na spravu za abdukciju i odaberi opterećenje koje ti odgovara. Kad su noge pravilno postavljene, uhvati ručke sa strane. Cijeli gornji dio tijela (od struka naviše) miruje. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah polako razmiči noge, gurajući jastučiće prema van.
Osjeti kontrakciju sekundu, a zatim uz udah vrati noge u početni položaj. Napomena: gornji dio tijela drži mirnim, da izbjegneš ozljede.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: To begin, sit down on the adductor machine and select a weight you are comfortable with. When your legs are positioned properly on the leg pads of the machine, grip the handles on each side. Your entire upper body (from the waist up) should be stationary. This is the starting position.
Slowly press against the machine with your legs to move them towards each other while exhaling.

Feel the contraction for a second and begin to move your legs back to the starting position while breathing in. Note: Remember to keep your upper body stationary and avoid fast jerking motions in order to prevent any injuries from occurring.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Sjedni na spravu za addukciju i odaberi opterećenje koje ti odgovara. Kad su noge pravilno postavljene na jastučiće, uhvati ručke sa strane. Cijeli gornji dio tijela (od struka naviše) miruje. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah polako primiči noge jednu prema drugoj.
Osjeti kontrakciju sekundu, a zatim uz udah vrati noge u početni položaj. Napomena: gornji dio tijela drži mirnim i izbjegavaj brze trzaje, da izbjegneš ozljede.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Stand in front of a low pulley facing forward with one leg next to the pulley and the other one away.
Attach the ankle cuff to the cable and also to the ankle of the leg that is next to the pulley.
Now step out and away from the stack with a wide stance and grasp the bar of the pulley system.
Stand on the foot that does not have the ankle cuff (the far foot) and allow the leg with the cuff to be pulled towards the low pulley. This will be your starting position.
Now perform the movement by moving the leg with the ankle cuff in front of the far leg by using the inner thighs to abduct the hip. Breathe out during this portion of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then repeat the same movement with the opposite leg.
hr: Stani pokraj donjeg kolotura, licem naprijed, s jednom nogom bliže koloturu, a drugom dalje.
Zakači manžetu na kabel i oko gležnja noge koja je bliže koloturu.
Odmakni se od sprave u širok stav i uhvati se za okvir sprave.
Stani na nogu bez manžete (dalju nogu) i pusti da kabel povuče nogu s manžetom prema koloturu. To je početni položaj.
Unutarnjom stranom bedra povuci nogu s manžetom ispred stajne noge. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni.
Uz udah se polako vrati u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja, a zatim isto napravi drugom nogom.

en: Place a band around both ankles and another around both knees. There should be enough tension that they are tight when your feet are shoulder width apart.
To begin, take short steps forward alternating your left and right foot.
After several steps, do just the opposite and walk backward to where you started.
hr: Stavi jednu traku oko oba gležnja, a drugu oko oba koljena. Trake trebaju biti napete kad su stopala u širini ramena.
Hodaj naprijed kratkim koracima, naizmjence lijevom i desnom nogom.
Nakon nekoliko koraka hodaj unatrag do mjesta s kojeg si krenuo.

en: Adjust the padded lever of the calf raise machine to fit your height.

Place your shoulders under the pads provided and position your toes facing forward (or using any of the two other positions described at the beginning of the chapter). The balls of your feet should be secured on top of the calf block with the heels extending off it. Push the lever up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Namjesti polugu sprave za listove prema svojoj visini.

Postavi ramena ispod jastučića, a prste na stopalima okreni naprijed (ili prema van ili unutra). Prednji dio stopala je na podlošku, a pete vise preko ruba. Ispruži kukove i koljena da podigneš polugu i uspravi se. Koljena su lagano savijena, nikad zaključana. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah podigni pete što više možeš, ispružajući gležnjeve i stežući listove. Koljena cijelo vrijeme miruju. Zadrži sekundu u gornjem položaju prije spuštanja.
Uz udah polako spuštaj pete savijanjem gležnjeva dok se listovi ne istegnu.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Sit on the machine and place your toes on the lower portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off. Choose the toe positioning of your choice (forward, in, or out) as per the beginning of this chapter.

Place your lower thighs under the lever pad, which will need to be adjusted according to the height of your thighs. Now place your hands on top of the lever pad in order to prevent it from slipping forward.
Lift the lever slightly by pushing your heels up and release the safety bar. This will be your starting position.
Slowly lower your heels by bending at the ankles until the calves are fully stretched. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Raise the heels by extending the ankles as high as possible as you contract the calves and breathe out. Hold the top contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Sjedni na spravu i postavi prednji dio stopala na donji dio platforme, s petama preko ruba. Prste na stopalima okreni naprijed, unutra ili van.
Donji dio bedara postavi ispod jastučića poluge, namještenog prema visini bedara. Ruke stavi na jastučić da ne klizi naprijed.
Podigni pete da malo podigneš polugu i otpusti sigurnosnu polugu. To je početni položaj.
Uz udah polako spuštaj pete savijanjem gležnjeva dok se listovi potpuno ne istegnu.
Uz izdah podigni pete što više možeš, stežući listove. Zadrži sekundu u gornjem položaju.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the bar on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck).
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: For better range of motion you may also place the ball of your feet on a wooden block but be careful as this option requires more balance and a sturdy block.

Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Ovu vježbu radi sigurnosti najbolje je izvoditi u stalku za čučanj. Postavi šipku na stalak na visinu koja ti odgovara. Kad je šipka opterećena, stani ispod nje i nasloni je na stražnju stranu ramena (malo ispod vrata).
Uhvati šipku objema rukama sa strane i skini je sa stalka odgurivanjem nogama i istovremenim uspravljanjem trupa.

Odmakni se od stalka i postavi stopala u širinu ramena, s prstima malo okrenutima prema van. Glavu drži podignutom (pogled prema dolje remeti ravnotežu), a leđa ravnima. Koljena su lagano savijena, nikad zaključana. To je početni položaj. Savjet: za veći opseg pokreta možeš stati prednjim dijelom stopala na stabilan podložak, ali to traži više ravnoteže.
Uz izdah podigni pete što više možeš, ispružajući gležnjeve i stežući listove. Koljena cijelo vrijeme miruju. Zadrži sekundu u gornjem položaju prije spuštanja.
Uz udah polako spuštaj pete savijanjem gležnjeva dok se listovi ne istegnu.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. Place the ball of the foot on a sturdy and stable wooden board (that is around 2-3 inches tall) while your heels extend off and touch the floor. This will be your starting position.

With the toes pointing either straight (to hit all parts equally), inwards (for emphasis on the outer head) or outwards (for emphasis on the inner head), raise the heels off the floor as you exhale by contracting the calves. Hold the top contraction for a second.
As you inhale, go back to the starting position by slowly lowering the heels.
Repeat for the recommended amount of times.
hr: Stani uspravno s bučicom u svakoj ruci uz tijelo. Prednji dio stopala postavi na stabilan podložak visok 5 do 8 centimetara, a pete neka vise i dodiruju pod. To je početni položaj.
S prstima okrenutima ravno (za cijeli list), prema unutra (za vanjski dio) ili prema van (za unutarnji dio), uz izdah podigni pete stežući listove. Zadrži sekundu u gornjem položaju.
Uz udah se polako vrati u početni položaj spuštanjem peta.
Ponovi preporučeni broj puta.

name.en: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
name.hr: Listovi na spravi za potisak nogu

en: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance.

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you without locking your knees. (Note: In some leg press units you can leave the safety bars on for increased safety. If your leg press unit allows for this, then this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) Your torso and the legs should make perfect 90-degree angle. Now carefully place your toes and balls of your feet on the lower portion of the platform with the heels extending off. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Press on the platform by raising your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Sjedni na spravu za potisak nogama i postavi stopala na platformu ispred sebe u širinu ramena.

Otpusti sigurnosne poluge i potisni platformu do kraja, dok se noge ne ispruže, ali ne zaključavaj koljena. (Napomena: na nekim spravama sigurnosne poluge mogu ostati uključene, i tada je to bolji način.) Trup i noge zatvaraju kut od 90 stupnjeva. Pažljivo postavi prste i prednji dio stopala na donji dio platforme, s petama preko ruba. Prsti gledaju naprijed, van ili unutra. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah potisni platformu podizanjem peta, ispružajući gležnjeve što više možeš i stežući listove. Koljena cijelo vrijeme miruju. Zadrži sekundu u gornjem položaju prije spuštanja.
Uz udah polako spuštaj pete savijanjem gležnjeva dok se listovi ne istegnu.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

name.hr: Podizanje na prste na Smith spravi

en: Place a block or weight plate below the bar on the Smith machine. Set the bar to a position that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step onto the plates with the balls of your feet and place the bar on the back of your shoulders.
Take the bar with both hands facing forward. Rotate the bar to unrack it. This will be your starting position.

Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing off of the balls of your feet, flexing your calf at the top of the contraction. Your knees should remain extended. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go back down.
Return slowly to the starting position as you breathe in while lowering your heels.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Ispod šipke Smith sprave postavi podložak ili ploču. Šipku namjesti na visinu koja ti odgovara. Kad je šipka opterećena, stani prednjim dijelom stopala na podložak i nasloni šipku na stražnju stranu ramena.
Uhvati šipku objema rukama, s dlanovima prema naprijed, i okreni je da je otključaš. To je početni položaj.
Podigni pete što više možeš, odgurujući se prednjim dijelom stopala, i na vrhu stisni listove. Koljena ostaju ispružena. Zadrži sekundu u gornjem položaju prije spuštanja.
Uz udah se polako vrati u početni položaj spuštanjem peta.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: For this exercise you will need access to a donkey calf raise machine. Start by positioning your lower back and hips under the padded lever provided. The tailbone area should be the one making contact with the pad.

Place both of your arms on the side handles and place the balls of your feet on the calf block with the heels extending off. Align the toes forward, inward or outward, depending on the area you wish to target, and straighten the knees without locking them. This will be your starting position.

Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Za ovu vježbu trebaš spravu za donkey podizanje na prste. Postavi donji dio leđa i kukove ispod jastučića poluge, tako da jastučić dodiruje područje trtične kosti.

Uhvati bočne ručke i postavi prednji dio stopala na podložak, s petama preko ruba. Prste okreni naprijed, unutra ili van, ovisno o dijelu lista koji želiš naglasiti, i ispruži koljena bez zaključavanja. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah podigni pete što više možeš, ispružajući gležnjeve i stežući listove. Koljena cijelo vrijeme miruju. Zadrži sekundu u gornjem položaju prije spuštanja.
Uz udah polako spuštaj pete savijanjem gležnjeva dok se listovi ne istegnu.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground, or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle. If you are resting your feet on a bench, place them three to four inches apart and point your toes inward so they touch.
Now place your hands lightly on either side of your head keeping your elbows in. Tip: Don't lock your fingers behind your head.
While pushing the small of your back down in the floor to better isolate your abdominal muscles, begin to roll your shoulders off the floor.

Continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back as you contract your abdominals and exhale. Your shoulders should come up off the floor only about four inches, and your lower back should remain on the floor. At the top of the movement, contract your abdominals hard and keep the contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
After the one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Lezi na leđa, sa stopalima na podu ili na klupi i koljenima savijenima pod 90 stupnjeva. Ako su stopala na klupi, razmakni ih 8 do 10 centimetara i okreni prste prema unutra da se dodiruju.
Lagano stavi šake sa strane glave, s laktovima prema unutra. Savjet: ne isprepliću prste iza glave.
Pritišćući donji dio leđa u pod, da bolje izoliraš trbušne mišiće, počni odizati ramena od poda.

Uz izdah nastavi pritiskati donja leđa u pod i stezati trbušne mišiće. Ramena se odižu samo desetak centimetara, a donji dio leđa ostaje na podu. Na vrhu snažno stisni trbušne mišiće i zadrži sekundu. Savjet: pokret je spor i kontroliran, bez zamaha.
Nakon sekunde uz udah se polako spusti u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Kneel below a high pulley that contains a rope attachment.
Grasp cable rope attachment and lower the rope until your hands are placed next to your face.
Flex your hips slightly and allow the weight to hyperextend the lower back. This will be your starting position.

With the hips stationary, flex the waist as you contract the abs so that the elbows travel towards the middle of the thighs. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction for a second.

Slowly return to the starting position as you inhale. Tip: Make sure that you keep constant tension on the abs throughout the movement. Also, do not choose a weight so heavy that the lower back handles the brunt of the work.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Klekni ispod gornjeg kolotura s užetom.
Uhvati uže i spusti ga dok šake ne budu uz lice.
Lagano savij kukove i pusti da teret lagano izvije donji dio leđa. To je početni položaj.
S kukovima mirnima, savij trup stežući trbušne mišiće, tako da laktovi idu prema sredini bedara. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni i zadrži sekundu.
Uz udah se polako vrati u početni položaj. Savjet: trbušni mišići su cijelo vrijeme pod opterećenjem. Ne biraj toliku težinu da glavni posao preuzmu donja leđa.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Select a light resistance and sit down on the ab machine placing your feet under the pads provided and grabbing the top handles. Your arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle as you rest the triceps on the pads provided. This will be your starting position.

At the same time, begin to lift the legs up as you crunch your upper torso. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Tip: Be sure to use a slow and controlled motion. Concentrate on using your abs to move the weight while relaxing your legs and feet.
After a second pause, slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
hr: Odaberi lagano opterećenje i sjedni na spravu za trbušnjake, sa stopalima ispod jastučića i rukama na gornjim ručkama. Ruke su savijene pod 90 stupnjeva, a tricepsi naslonjeni na jastučiće. To je početni položaj.
Istovremeno podigni noge i savij gornji dio trupa. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni. Savjet: pokret je spor i kontroliran. Teret pomiči trbušnim mišićima, a noge i stopala neka budu opušteni.
Nakon sekunde uz udah se polako vrati u početni položaj.
Ponovi pokret zadani broj ponavljanja.

en: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down.
Now place your hands lightly on either side of your head keeping your elbows in. Tip: Don't lock your fingers behind your head.
While pushing the small of your back down in the bench to better isolate your abdominal muscles, begin to roll your shoulders off it.

Continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back as you contract your abdominals and exhale. Your shoulders should come up off the bench only about four inches, and your lower back should remain on the bench. At the top of the movement, contract your abdominals hard and keep the contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
After the one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Učvrsti noge na kraju negativne klupe i lezi.
Lagano stavi šake sa strane glave, s laktovima prema unutra. Savjet: ne isprepliću prste iza glave.
Pritišćući donji dio leđa u klupu, da bolje izoliraš trbušne mišiće, počni odizati ramena od klupe.

Uz izdah nastavi pritiskati donja leđa u klupu i stezati trbušne mišiće. Ramena se odižu samo desetak centimetara, a donji dio leđa ostaje na klupi. Na vrhu snažno stisni trbušne mišiće i zadrži sekundu. Savjet: pokret je spor i kontroliran, bez zamaha.
Nakon sekunde uz udah se polako spusti u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Lie down on the floor with your legs fully extended and arms to the side of your torso with the palms on the floor. Your arms should be stationary for the entire exercise.
Move your legs up so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and feet are together and parallel to the floor. This is the starting position.
While inhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the floor. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Lezi na pod s potpuno ispruženim nogama i rukama uz trup, dlanovima na podu. Ruke miruju tijekom cijele vježbe.
Podigni noge tako da su natkoljenice okomite na pod, a stopala spojena i paralelna s podom. To je početni položaj.
Privuci noge prema trupu, zarotiraj zdjelicu unatrag i odigni kukove od poda. Na kraju pokreta koljena dodiruju prsa. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni.
Zadrži sekundu i uz udah vrati noge u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Lezi na pod, sa stopalima zakvačenima ispod nečeg stabilnog ili neka ih partner drži. Koljena su savijena.
Stavi šake iza glave. To je početni položaj.
Podigni gornji dio tijela tako da s bedrima čini zamišljeno slovo V. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni.
Zadrži sekundu, a zatim uz udah spusti gornji dio tijela u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Lie flat on the floor (or exercise mat) on your back with your arms extended straight back behind your head and your legs extended also. This will be your starting position.

As you exhale, bend at the waist while simultaneously raising your legs and arms to meet in a jackknife position. Tip: The legs should be extended and lifted at approximately a 35-45 degree angle from the floor and the arms should be extended and parallel to your legs. The upper torso should be off the floor.
While inhaling, lower your arms and legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Lezi na leđa na pod ili prostirku, s rukama ispruženima iza glave i ispruženim nogama. To je početni položaj.

Uz izdah se savij u struku i istovremeno podigni noge i ruke da se susretnu, kao nož koji se sklapa. Savjet: noge su ispružene i podignute pod kutom od 35 do 45 stupnjeva od poda, a ruke ispružene i paralelne s nogama. Gornji dio trupa je odignut od poda.
Uz udah spusti ruke i noge u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.

Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position.
Twist your torso to the right side until your arms are parallel with the floor while breathing out.
Hold the contraction for a second and move back to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite side performing the same techniques you applied to the right side.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Sjedni na pod, sa stopalima zakvačenima ispod nečeg stabilnog ili neka ih partner drži. Koljena su savijena.
Nagni gornji dio tijela unatrag tako da s bedrima čini zamišljeno slovo V. Ruke su potpuno ispružene ispred tebe, okomito na trup, sa spojenim šakama. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah zarotiraj trup udesno dok ruke ne budu paralelne s podom.
Zadrži sekundu i uz udah se vrati u početni položaj. Zatim isto napravi na drugu stranu.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and your forearms. Your arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.
hr: Postavi se licem prema podu, oslonjen na prste stopala i podlaktice. Ruke su savijene, a laktovi točno ispod ramena.
Tijelo je cijelo vrijeme ravno. Zadrži položaj što dulje možeš. Za težu varijantu podigni jednu ruku ili nogu.

en: Begin lying on your back with your hands extended above you toward the ceiling.
Bring your feet, knees, and hips up to 90 degrees.

Exhale hard to bring your ribcage down and flatten your back onto the floor, rotating your pelvis up and squeezing your glutes. Hold this position throughout the movement. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the exercise by extending one leg, straightening the knee and hip to bring the leg just above the ground.
Maintain the position of your lumbar and pelvis as you perform the movement, as your back is going to want to arch.
Stay tight and return the working leg to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side, alternating until the set is complete.
hr: Lezi na leđa s rukama ispruženima prema stropu.
Podigni stopala tako da su kukovi i koljena savijeni pod 90 stupnjeva.
Snažno izdahni da spustiš rebra i priljubiš leđa uz pod, zarotiraj zdjelicu prema gore i stisni gluteuse. Zadrži taj položaj tijekom cijelog pokreta. To je početni položaj.
Ispruži jednu nogu, ispružajući koljeno i kuk, tako da noga bude tik iznad poda.
Tijekom pokreta zadrži položaj donjih leđa i zdjelice, jer će se leđa htjeti izviti.
Ostani stegnut i vrati nogu u početni položaj.
Ponovi drugom stranom i nastavi naizmjence do kraja serije.

en: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.
Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench. This will be your starting position.

As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible with your knees slightly bent but locked raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
hr: Lezi leđima na ravnu klupu, s nogama ispruženima preko kraja klupe.
Šake stavi ispod gluteusa s dlanovima prema dolje ili se drži za klupu sa strane. To je početni položaj.
Držeći noge ispruženima, s koljenima tek malo savijenima, podigni ih dok ne zatvore kut od 90 stupnjeva s podom. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni i zadrži sekundu na vrhu.
Uz udah polako spusti noge u početni položaj.

en: Hold the Ab Roller with both hands and kneel on the floor.
Now place the ab roller on the floor in front of you so that you are on all your hands and knees (as in a kneeling push up position). This will be your starting position.

Slowly roll the ab roller straight forward, stretching your body into a straight position. Tip: Go down as far as you can without touching the floor with your body. Breathe in during this portion of the movement.
After a pause at the stretched position, start pulling yourself back to the starting position as you breathe out. Tip: Go slowly and keep your abs tight at all times.
hr: Drži kotačić objema rukama i klekni na pod.
Postavi kotačić na pod ispred sebe, tako da si oslonjen na ruke i koljena (kao za sklek na koljenima). To je početni položaj.
Polako kotrljaj kotačić ravno naprijed, ispružajući tijelo. Savjet: idi što dalje možeš a da tijelom ne dotakneš pod. Tijekom ovog dijela udahni.
Nakon pauze u ispruženom položaju uz izdah se povuci natrag u početni položaj. Savjet: idi polako, a trbuh neka bude cijelo vrijeme stegnut.

en: For this exercise you will need to get into a pushup position, but instead of having your hands of the floor, you will be grabbing on to an Olympic barbell (loaded with 5-10 lbs on each side) instead. This will be your starting position.

While keeping a slight arch on your back, lift your hips and roll the barbell towards your feet as you exhale. Tip: As you perform the movement, your glutes should be coming up, you should be keeping the abs tight and should maintain your back posture at all times. Also your arms should be staying perpendicular to the floor throughout the movement. If you don't, you will work out your shoulders and back more than the abs.
After a second contraction at the top, start to roll the barbell back forward to the starting position slowly as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Postavi se kao za sklek, ali umjesto na pod oslanjaš se rukama na olimpijsku šipku s 2 do 5 kg sa svake strane. To je početni položaj.

S blago izvijenim leđima podigni kukove i uz izdah kotrljaj šipku prema stopalima. Savjet: gluteusi se podižu, trbuh je stegnut, a držanje leđa isto cijelo vrijeme. Ruke su okomite na pod tijekom cijelog pokreta, inače više rade ramena i leđa nego trbuh.
Nakon sekunde u gornjem položaju uz udah polako kotrljaj šipku natrag u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and—if possible—position the cable to shoulder height. If not, a low pulley will suffice.
With your side to the cable, grab the handle with both hands and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable.
With your feet positioned hip-width apart and knees slightly bent, hold the cable to the middle of your chest. This will be your starting position.
Press the cable away from your chest, fully extending both arms. You core should be tight and engaged.
Hold the repetition for several seconds before returning to the starting position.
At the conclusion of the set, repeat facing the other direction.
hr: Zakači ručku na kolotur i, ako možeš, postavi ga u visinu ramena. Ako ne, dovoljan je i donji kolotur.
Okrenut bokom prema spravi, uhvati ručku objema rukama i odmakni se. Trebaš biti otprilike na duljinu ruke od kolotura, s kablom pod napetošću.
Sa stopalima u širini kukova i lagano savijenim koljenima drži ručku uz sredinu prsa. To je početni položaj.
Potisni ručku od prsa dok se obje ruke potpuno ne ispruže. Trup je stegnut.
Zadrži nekoliko sekundi, a zatim se vrati u početni položaj.
Na kraju serije ponovi okrenut na drugu stranu.

en: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and move the cable to the highest pulley position.

With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable. Your outstretched arm should be aligned with the cable.
With your feet positioned shoulder width apart, reach upward with your other hand and grab the handle with both hands. Your arms should still be fully extended.
In one motion, pull the handle down and across your body to your front knee while rotating your torso.
Keep your back and arms straight and core tight while you pivot your back foot and bend your knees to get a full range of motion.
Maintain your stance and straight arms. Return to the neutral position in a slow and controlled manner.
Repeat to failure.
Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.
hr: Zakači ručku na kolotur i postavi ga u najviši položaj.
Okrenut bokom prema spravi, uhvati ručku jednom rukom i odmakni se. Trebaš biti otprilike na duljinu ruke od kolotura, s kablom pod napetošću. Ispružena ruka je u liniji s kablom.
Sa stopalima u širini ramena posegni gore drugom rukom i uhvati ručku objema rukama. Ruke su i dalje potpuno ispružene.
Jednim pokretom povuci ručku dolje i dijagonalno preko tijela do prednjeg koljena, rotirajući trup.
Leđa i ruke su ravni, a trup stegnut, dok se okrećeš na stražnjem stopalu i savijaš koljena za puni opseg pokreta.
Zadrži stav i ravne ruke. Polako i kontrolirano se vrati u početni položaj.
Ponavljaj do otkaza.
Zatim se okreni i ponovi isto na drugu stranu.

en: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on the left hand (palms facing the torso) as you have the right hand holding your waist. Your feet should be placed at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.

While keeping your back straight and your head up, bend only at the waist to the right as far as possible. Breathe in as you bend to the side. Then hold for a second and come back up to the starting position as you exhale. Tip: Keep the rest of the body stationary.
Now repeat the movement but bending to the left instead. Hold for a second and come back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then change hands.
hr: Stani uspravno s bučicom u lijevoj ruci (dlan prema trupu), a desnu ruku stavi na struk. Stopala su u širini ramena. To je početni položaj.
Ravnih leđa i podignute glave nagni se samo u struku udesno, koliko možeš. Tijekom naginjanja udahni. Zadrži sekundu i uz izdah se vrati u početni položaj. Savjet: ostatak tijela miruje.
Ponovi pokret naginjući se ulijevo. Zadrži sekundu i vrati se u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja, a zatim zamijeni ruke.

en: Begin in a pushup position, with your weight supported by your hands and toes. Flexing the knee and hip, bring one leg until the knee is approximately under the hip. This will be your starting position.

Explosively reverse the positions of your legs, extending the bent leg until the leg is straight and supported by the toe, and bringing the other foot up with the hip and knee flexed. Repeat in an alternating fashion for 20-30 seconds.
hr: Postavi se kao za sklek, oslonjen na šake i prste stopala. Savij koljeno i kuk i privuci jednu nogu dok koljeno ne bude otprilike ispod kuka. To je početni položaj.
Eksplozivno zamijeni položaj nogu: savijenu nogu ispruži i osloni na prste, a drugu privuci savijenog koljena i kuka. Ponavljaj naizmjence 20 do 30 sekundi.

en: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground. For this exercise, you will need to put your hands beside your head. Be careful however to not strain with the neck as you perform it. Now lift your shoulders into the crunch position.
Bring knees up to where they are perpendicular to the floor, with your lower legs parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position.

Now simultaneously, slowly go through a cycle pedal motion kicking forward with the right leg and bringing in the knee of the left leg. Bring your right elbow close to your left knee by crunching to the side, as you breathe out.
Go back to the initial position as you breathe in.
Crunch to the opposite side as you cycle your legs and bring closer your left elbow to your right knee and exhale.
Continue alternating in this manner until all of the recommended repetitions for each side have been completed.
hr: Lezi na pod s donjim dijelom leđa priljubljenim uz pod. Šake stavi sa strane glave, pazeći da ne vučeš vrat. Odigni ramena kao za trbušnjak.
Podigni koljena tako da su natkoljenice okomite na pod, a potkoljenice paralelne s njim. To je početni položaj.
Polako napravi pokret kao da voziš bicikl: desnu nogu ispruži naprijed, a lijevo koljeno privuci. Uz izdah se savij u stranu i približi desni lakat lijevom koljenu.
Uz udah se vrati u početni položaj.
Uz izdah se savij na drugu stranu, mijenjajući noge, i približi lijevi lakat desnom koljenu.
Nastavi naizmjence dok ne napraviš sva preporučena ponavljanja na svaku stranu.

en: Lay flat on the floor with your arms next to your sides.
Now bend your knees at around a 75 degree angle and lift your feet off the floor by around 2 inches.

Using your lower abs, bring your knees in towards you as you maintain the 75 degree angle bend in your legs. Continue this movement until you raise your hips off of the floor by rolling your pelvis backward. Breathe out as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: At the end of the movement your knees will be over your chest.
Squeeze your abs at the top of the movement for a second and then return to the starting position slowly as you breathe in. Tip: Maintain a controlled motion at all times.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Lezi na pod s rukama uz tijelo.
Savij koljena pod kutom od otprilike 75 stupnjeva i odigni stopala oko 5 centimetara od poda.

Donjim dijelom trbuha privuci koljena prema sebi, zadržavajući isti kut u koljenima. Nastavi dok ne odigneš kukove od poda, rotirajući zdjelicu unatrag. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni. Savjet: na kraju pokreta koljena su iznad prsa.
Na vrhu stisni trbuh na sekundu, a zatim se uz udah polako vrati u početni položaj. Savjet: pokret je cijelo vrijeme kontroliran.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Position your body on the vertical leg raise bench so that your forearms are resting on the pads next to the torso and holding on to the handles. Your arms will be bent at a 90 degree angle.
The torso should be straight with the lower back pressed against the pad of the machine and the legs extended pointing towards the floor. This will be your starting position.

Now as you breathe out, lift your legs up as you keep them extended. Continue this movement until your legs are roughly parallel to the floor and then hold the contraction for a second. Tip: Do not use any momentum or swinging as you perform this exercise.
Slowly go back to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Postavi se na stalak za podizanje nogu tako da su podlaktice na jastučićima uz trup, a šake drže ručke. Ruke su savijene pod 90 stupnjeva.
Trup je uspravan, donji dio leđa naslonjen na naslon, a noge ispružene prema podu. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah podigni noge, savijajući koljena prema prsima, dok natkoljenice ne budu otprilike paralelne s podom. Zadrži sekundu. Savjet: bez zamaha i njihanja.
Uz udah se polako vrati u početni položaj.
Ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: Hang from a chin-up bar with both arms extended at arms length in top of you using either a wide grip or a medium grip. The legs should be straight down with the pelvis rolled slightly backwards. This will be your starting position.
Raise your legs until the torso makes a 90-degree angle with the legs. Exhale as you perform this movement and hold the contraction for a second or so.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Uhvati šipku za zgibove širokim ili srednjim hvatom i visi ispruženih ruku. Noge su ispružene prema dolje, a zdjelica blago zarotirana unatrag. To je početni položaj.
Uz izdah podiži noge dok trup i noge ne zatvore kut od 90 stupnjeva. Zadrži otprilike sekundu.
Uz udah polako se vrati u početni položaj.
Ponovi pokret zadani broj ponavljanja.

en: Lie on your side on a mat with your legs straight and stacked. Place the forearm of the lower arm on the floor, with the elbow directly under the shoulder.
Lift your hips off the floor so that your body forms a straight line from head to feet. Keep your core tight and do not let your hips sag. This will be your starting position.
Hold the position for the recommended amount of time while breathing steadily.
Lower your hips back to the floor and repeat on the other side.
hr: Lezi na bok na prostirku s ispruženim nogama jednom na drugoj. Podlakticu donje ruke stavi na pod, s laktom točno ispod ramena.
Podigni kukove od poda tako da tijelo bude u ravnoj liniji od glave do stopala. Trbuh drži čvrsto i ne dopusti da kukovi propadnu. To je početni položaj.
Zadrži položaj zadano vrijeme i ravnomjerno diši.
Spusti kukove na pod i ponovi na drugoj strani.

en: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and toes pointing out slightly.
Squat down and grasp bar with a closed, pronated grip. Your hands should be slightly wider than shoulder width apart outside knees with elbows fully extended.
Place the bar about 1 inch in front of your shins and over the balls of your feet.
Your back should be flat or slightly arched, your chest held up and out and your shoulder blades should be retracted.
Keep your head in a neutral position (in line with vertebral column and not tilted or rotated) with your eyes focused straight ahead. Inhale during this phase.

Lift the bar from the floor by forcefully extending the hips and the knees as you exhale. Tip: The upper torso should maintain the same angle. Do not bend at the waist yet and do not let the hips rise before the shoulders (this would have the effect of pushing the glutes in the air and stretching the hamstrings.
Keep elbows fully extended with the head in a neutral position and the shoulders over the bar.
As the bar raises keep it as close to the shins as possible.
As the bar passes the knees, thrust your hips forward and slightly bend the knees to avoid locking them. Tip: At this point your thighs should be against the bar.
Keep the back flat or slightly arched, elbows fully extended and your head neutral. Tip: You will hold your breath until the next phase.
Inhale and then forcefully and quickly extend your hips and knees and stand on your toes.

Keep the bar as close to your body as possible. Tip: Your back should be flat with the elbows pointed out to the sides and your head in a neutral position. Also, keep your shoulders over the bar and arms straight as long as possible.
When your lower body joints are fully extended, shrug the shoulders upward rapidly without letting the elbows flex yet. Exhale during this portion of the movement.
As the shoulders reach their highest elevation flex your elbows to begin pulling your body under the bar.

Continue to pull the arms as high and as long as possible. Tip: Due to the explosive nature of this phase, your torso will be erect or with an arched back, your head will be tilted back slightly and your feet may lose contact with the floor.
After the lower body has fully extended and the bar reaches near maximal height, pull your body under the bar and rotate the arms around and under the bar.
Simultaneously, flex the hips and knees into a quarter squat position.
Once the arms are under the bar, inhale and then lift your elbows to position the upper arms parallel to the floor. Rack the bar across the front of your collar bones and front shoulder muscles.
Catch the bar with an erect and tight torso, a neutral head position and flat feet. Exhale during this movement.
Stand up by extending the hips and knees to a fully erect position.
Lower the bar by gradually reducing the muscular tension of the arms to allow a controlled descent of the bar to the thighs. Inhale during this movement.
Simultaneously flex the hips and knees to cushion the impact of the bar on the thighs.
Squat down with the elbows fully extended until the bar touches the floor.
Start over at Phase 1 and repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
hr: Stani sa stopalima malo šire od ramena i prstima malo okrenutima prema van.
Čučni i uhvati šipku zatvorenim nathvatom. Šake su malo šire od ramena, izvan koljena, a laktovi potpuno ispruženi.
Šipka je oko 2 centimetra ispred potkoljenica, iznad prednjeg dijela stopala.
Leđa su ravna ili blago izvijena, prsa isturena, a lopatice skupljene.
Glava je u neutralnom položaju (u liniji s kralježnicom), a pogled ravno naprijed. U ovoj fazi udahni.
Uz izdah snažno ispruži kukove i koljena i podigni šipku s poda. Savjet: gornji dio trupa zadržava isti kut. Ne savijaj se još u struku i ne dopusti da se kukovi podignu prije ramena.
Laktovi su potpuno ispruženi, glava neutralna, a ramena iznad šipke.
Dok se šipka podiže, drži je što bliže potkoljenicama.
Kad šipka prođe koljena, gurni kukove naprijed i lagano savij koljena da ih ne zaključaš. Savjet: bedra su sada uz šipku.
Leđa su ravna ili blago izvijena, laktovi ispruženi, a glava neutralna. Savjet: zadrži dah do sljedeće faze.
Udahni, a zatim snažno i brzo ispruži kukove i koljena i propni se na prste.
Šipku drži što bliže tijelu. Savjet: leđa su ravna, laktovi okrenuti u stranu, glava neutralna. Ramena drži iznad šipke, a ruke ravne što dulje.
Kad su zglobovi nogu potpuno ispruženi, brzo slegni ramenima prema gore, a laktove još ne savijaj. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni.
Kad su ramena na najvišoj točki, savij laktove i počni se povlačiti ispod šipke.
Nastavi vući rukama što više i što dulje. Savjet: zbog eksplozivnosti ove faze trup je uspravan ili izvijen, glava malo zabačena, a stopala se mogu odvojiti od poda.
Kad su noge potpuno ispružene, a šipka gotovo na najvišoj točki, povuci se ispod šipke i zarotiraj ruke oko i ispod nje.
Istovremeno savij kukove i koljena u četvrtinu čučnja.
Kad su ruke ispod šipke, udahni i podigni laktove tako da su nadlaktice paralelne s podom. Prihvati šipku na prednju stranu ključnih kostiju i ramena.
Prihvati šipku uspravnim i stegnutim trupom, neutralnom glavom i stopalima cijelom površinom na podu. Tijekom ovog dijela izdahni.
Uspravi se ispružanjem kukova i koljena.
Spusti šipku postupno popuštajući napetost u rukama, kontrolirano do bedara. Tijekom ovog dijela udahni.
Istovremeno savij kukove i koljena da ublažiš udar šipke o bedra.
Čučni s ispruženim laktovima dok šipka ne dotakne pod.
Kreni ponovno od prve faze i ponovi preporučeni broj ponavljanja.

en: With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take an overhand (or hook) grip just outside the legs. Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels, back straight, head facing forward, chest up, with your shoulders just in front of the bar. This will be your starting position.

Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your back angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees.

Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the clean. As the bar approaches the mid-thigh position, begin extending through the hips. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the hips, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended.

As full extension is achieved, transition into the third pull by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the elbows up and out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating your elbows under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat position, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third pull. The bar should be racked onto the protracted shoulders, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat position, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Continue until you have risen to a standing position.
hr: Šipka je na podu blizu potkoljenica. Uhvati je nathvatom (ili hook hvatom) tik izvan nogu. Spusti kukove s težinom na petama, ravnih leđa, pogleda naprijed i podignutih prsa, s ramenima malo ispred šipke. To je početni položaj.
Prvo povlačenje: odgurni se petama i ispruži koljena. Kut leđa ostaje isti, a ruke ravne. Kontrolirano podiži šipku do iznad koljena.

Drugo povlačenje glavni je izvor ubrzanja. Kad šipka dođe do sredine bedara, počni ispružati kukove. Pokretom kao u skoku ubrzaj šipku ispružanjem kukova, koljena i gležnjeva. Rukama ne trebaš aktivno vući: na kraju drugog povlačenja tijelo je potpuno ispruženo, malo nagnuto unatrag, a ruke su i dalje ispružene.

Na potpunom ispruženju prijeđi u treće povlačenje: snažno slegni ramenima i savij ruke, s laktovima gore i van. Na vrhu se snažno povuci dolje, rotirajući laktove ispod šipke. Prihvati šipku u prednji čučanj, čija dubina ovisi o visini šipke na kraju trećeg povlačenja. Šipka leži na ramenima, lagano dodiruje vrat, a šake su opuštene. Nastavi do dna čučnja, jer to pomaže pri ustajanju.
Odmah se uspravi odgurivanjem petama, s uspravnim trupom i podignutim laktovima, dok ne ustaneš.

en: Begin with a shoulder width, double overhand or hook grip, with the bar hanging at the mid thigh position. Your back should be straight and inclined slightly forward.
Begin by aggressively extending through the hips, knees and ankles, driving the weight upward. As you do so, shrug your shoulders towards your ears.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Continue until you have risen to a standing position.
hr: Uhvati šipku u širini ramena, nathvatom ili hook hvatom. Šipka visi na sredini bedara. Leđa su ravna i malo nagnuta naprijed.
Snažno ispruži kukove, koljena i gležnjeve i potjeraj šipku prema gore. Pritom slegni ramenima prema ušima.
Prihvati šipku na prednju stranu ramena u čučnju i odmah se uspravi odgurivanjem petama, s uspravnim trupom i podignutim laktovima, dok ne ustaneš.

en: Place your feet at a shoulder width stance with the barbell resting right above the connection between the toes and the rest of the foot.

With a palms facing down grip, bend at the knees and keeping the back flat grab the bar using a wider than shoulder width grip. Bring the hips down and make sure that your body drops as if you were going to sit on a chair. This will be your starting position.
Start pushing the floor as if it were a moving platform with your feet and simultaneously start lifting the barbell keeping it close to your legs.
As the bar reaches the middle of your thighs, push the floor with your legs and lift your body to a complete extension in an explosive motion.
Lift your shoulders back in a shrugging movement as you bring the bar up while lifting your elbows out to the side and keeping them above the bar for as long as possible.

Now in a very quick but powerful motion, you have to get your body under the barbell when it has reached a high enough point where it can be controlled and drop while locking your arms and holding the barbell overhead as you assume a squat position.
Finalize the movement by rising up out of the squat position to finish the lift. At the end of the lift both feet should be on line and the arms fully extended holding the barbell overhead.
hr: Stani sa stopalima u širini ramena. Šipka je iznad mjesta gdje prsti prelaze u stopalo.
Savij koljena i ravnih leđa uhvati šipku nathvatom širim od ramena. Spusti kukove kao da sjedaš na stolac. To je početni položaj.
Počni gurati pod stopalima i istovremeno podiži šipku, držeći je blizu nogu.
Kad šipka dođe do sredine bedara, snažno se odgurni nogama i eksplozivno ispruži cijelo tijelo.
Dok šipka ide gore, slegni ramenima unatrag i podiži laktove u stranu, držeći ih iznad šipke što dulje.
Kad šipka dosegne dovoljnu visinu da je možeš kontrolirati, vrlo brzim i snažnim pokretom spusti se ispod nje u čučanj, zaključaj ruke i drži šipku iznad glave.
Završi dizanje ustajanjem iz čučnja. Na kraju su stopala u liniji, a ruke potpuno ispružene sa šipkom iznad glave.

en: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. A 150 lb person will burn over 450 calories running 8 miles per hour for 30 minutes. Maintain proper posture as you run, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.
hr: Stani na traku i odaberi željenu opciju u izborniku. Većina traka ima ručni način, a možeš odabrati i program. Obično možeš upisati dob i težinu za procjenu potrošenih kalorija. Nagibom mijenjaš intenzitet treninga.

Traka je praktična, dobra za srce i obično manje opterećuje zglobove od trčanja vani. Osoba od 70 kg potroši više od 450 kcal trčeći 30 minuta brzinom od 13 km/h. Trči pravilnog držanja i drži se za ručke samo kad treba, primjerice pri silasku ili mjerenju pulsa.
