Ručke mogu mjeriti puls, da ostaneš u odgovarajućem intenzitetu.

en: To begin, seat yourself on the rower. Make sure that your heels are resting comfortably against the base of the foot pedals and that the straps are secured. Select the program that you wish to use, if applicable. Sit up straight and bend forward at the hips.

There are three phases of movement when using a rower. The first phase is when you come forward on the rower. Your knees are bent and against your chest. Your upper body is leaning slightly forward while still maintaining good posture. Next, push against the foot pedals and extend your legs while bringing your hands to your upper abdominal area, squeezing your shoulders back as you do so. To avoid straining your back, use primarily your leg and hip muscles.
The recovery phase simply involves straightening your arms, bending the knees, and bringing your body forward again as you transition back into the first phase.
hr: Sjedni na veslački trenažer. Pete neka udobno leže na dnu papučica, a remenje bude zategnuto. Ako trenažer to nudi, odaberi program. Sjedni uspravno i nagni se naprijed iz kukova.

Zaveslaj ima tri faze. U prvoj se pomičeš naprijed: koljena su savijena uz prsa, a gornji dio tijela malo nagnut naprijed, uz dobro držanje. Zatim se odgurni od papučica i ispruži noge, povlačeći ručku do gornjeg dijela trbuha i skupljajući ramena unatrag. Da ne opteretiš leđa, radi uglavnom mišićima nogu i kukova.
U fazi povratka ispruži ruke, savij koljena i ponovno pomakni tijelo naprijed, u prvu fazu.

en: To begin, step onto the stairmaster and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

Pump your legs up and down in an established rhythm, driving the pedals down but not all the way to the floor. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Stairmasters offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.
hr: Stani na Stairmaster i odaberi željenu opciju u izborniku. Možeš odabrati ručni način ili program. Obično možeš upisati dob i težinu za procjenu potrošenih kalorija.
Ujednačenim ritmom gaži papučice gore-dolje, ali ih ne guraj skroz do poda. Preporučuje se držati se za ručke da ne padneš. Ručke mogu mjeriti puls, da ostaneš u odgovarajućem intenzitetu.

Stairmaster je praktičan, dobar za srce i obično manje opterećuje zglobove od trčanja vani. Obično je znatno zahtjevniji od druge kardio opreme. Osoba od 70 kg obično potroši više od 300 kcal u 30 minuta, a hodanjem oko 175 kcal.

en: Hold an end of the rope in each hand. Position the rope behind you on the ground. Raise your arms up and turn the rope over your head bringing it down in front of you. When it reaches the ground, jump over it. Find a good turning pace that can be maintained. Different speeds and techniques can be used to introduce variation.
Rope jumping is exciting, challenges your coordination, and requires a lot of energy. A 150 lb person will burn about 350 calories jumping rope for 30 minutes, compared to over 450 calories running.
hr: Drži po jedan kraj užeta u svakoj ruci, s užetom na podu iza sebe. Podigni ruke i zavrti uže preko glave prema naprijed. Kad dođe do poda, preskoči ga. Nađi tempo koji možeš održati. Brzinu i tehniku možeš mijenjati radi raznolikosti.
Preskakanje užeta je zabavno, izaziva koordinaciju i troši puno energije. Osoba od 70 kg potroši oko 350 kcal u 30 minuta, a trčanjem više od 450 kcal.

en: Running or hiking on trails will get the blood pumping and heart beating almost immediately. Make sure you have good shoes. While you use the muscles in your calves and buttocks to pull yourself up a hill, the knees, joints and ankles absorb the bulk of the pounding coming back down. Take smaller steps as you walk downhill, keep your knees bent to reduce the impact and slow down to avoid falling.
A 150 lb person can burn over 200 calories for 30 minutes walking uphill, compared to 175 on a flat surface. If running the trail, a 150 lb person can burn well over 500 calories in 30 minutes.
hr: Trčanje ili planinarenje po stazama gotovo odmah ubrza puls. Nosi dobru obuću. Dok se uzbrdo penješ snagom listova i gluteusa, nizbrdo glavni udar preuzimaju koljena, zglobovi i gležnjevi. Nizbrdo hodaj manjim koracima, sa savijenim koljenima da ublažiš udar, i uspori da ne padneš.
Osoba od 70 kg može potrošiti više od 200 kcal u 30 minuta hodanja uzbrdo, a oko 175 kcal po ravnom. Trčanjem po stazi u 30 minuta može potrošiti i znatno više od 500 kcal.
